verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a web-fetching and scraping API, since such services can offer scheduled crawls or monitoring. The evidence only documents on-demand, per-request features: URL conversion, search, headers, caching and self-hosting. Nothing shows a built-in recurring scheduler or workflow feature, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
